title: Recovering Latent Root Structure from Finite-Policy Records without Observing the Root Context
banked_reason: The exact population fiber is sound, but the field reviewer capped it at incremental because the engineered diagnostic interface reduces the headline to channel inversion and supplies no finite-sample stability, rates, inference, or substantive application.
gap_reasons: The note proves an exact population fiber and rank criterion only for a tightly engineered gate-isolated class with programmable latent-label replacements, no-bypass edge diagnostics, repeated same-instance probing, and gate–auxiliary conditional independence.
Once the all-horizons diagnostic scheme recovers (A,E) and active observations calibrate C, the headline recovery frontier reduces to finite-dimensional channel inversion.
The absence of finite-sample stability, rates, inference, or a substantive application leaves the contribution too specialized for the field tier.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived and independently audited an exact absent-mass fiber, a normalized rank iff with constructive positive twins, joint- and product-channel 2^d >= k thresholds, and all-horizons recovery of the designated gate pattern under an explicit finite diagnostic interface. A fixed-instance decoder gap was repaired with an almost-everywhere instancewise restriction and the complete-law attainability argument was rechecked under mutually absolutely continuous reweighting. The result remained incremental because reaching the field floor requires a new finite-sample stability program with estimators and matching risks.
tldr: Can beta-edge replacements recover a latent root's structure kernel when the root context is neither read nor intervened on? For a strict, gate-isolated subclass of finite ordered POSCMs, the complete family of raw finite-policy action-and-value records identifies the designated pattern \(S=(A,E)\) through a prefix-preserving all-horizons limit functional. The interface now explicitly places each auxiliary-dyad diagnostic \(v_{ju}^{(q)}\) in the \(V\)-action component, holds the designated replacement \(r^{(0)}\) fixed, and assumes no bypass when \(E_j=0\); no fixed finite transcript is assumed to reveal a gate. Under the sufficient transport condition \(A\mathbin{\perp\!\!\!\perp}E\mid B\), the note gives the exact absent-mass fiber, learns an arbitrary positive joint auxiliary-pattern channel, and proves the sharp possibility threshold \(2^d\ge k\), including the local positive product-Bernoulli subfamily. Positive gate--auxiliary-dependent and terminal \(QG\) twins remain separate boundaries.
gap: The initiating POSCM paper proves kernel recovery with readable contexts and beta-node controls, and Appendix C.1 leaves the intermediate beta-edge-only regime without beta-node interventions formally unresolved. It does not guarantee the label-indicator replacement menu, impose independent outgoing edges, or prove that equality of a few gate summaries entails equality of the complete acquired law. Generic latent-channel rank results likewise do not settle causal transport, normalization, or legal POSCM twins.
fill: It seeks an explicit policy-indexed factorization for every finite nonanticipating allowed experiment, a necessary-and-sufficient acquired-law fiber, a constructive inverse or positive twins, an ordinary-value three-node self-calibration theorem, a root-star full-rank frontier with \(2^d\ge k\), and explicit dependent-edge and terminal-factorization obstructions.
